rachel (devex): Heads-up: Eng Platform proposed a breaking-change window next month to lock the canonical routing header and route_id derivation. Need SDK coordination.

owen (eng-platform): Yes—proposal: canonical header name `X-Redwood-Route`, fields: tenant, shard:int, priority:string. We'll bump API spec and enable strict parsing behind feature-flag.

sam (sdk-python): Py SDK can add a compatibility layer to emit both legacy `X-Route-Id` and the new `X-Redwood-Route` for one release, but we need dates to coordinate release notes and customer notices.

marta (sdk-ts): TS team prefers non-duplicative approach; emitting both will confuse proxies that concat headers. Can we instead include a negotiation header `X-Redwood-Route-Version: 2` so servers know client supports v2 format?

leo (console): console needs a stable canonical_route field from telemetry to avoid duplicate rows. If we add negotiation header, ingestion must map older clients to canonical_route until they upgrade.

owen (eng-platform): negotiation header is fine. Plan: (1) publish spec and migration guide 2 weeks prior, (2) SDKs ship compatibility helpers and negotiation header in minor releases, (3) enable strict parsing behind FF 1 week later, (4) flip enforcement in breaking window.

sam (sdk-python): timeline sounds reasonable. We will target py-sdk 2.4.0 to include negotiation header and compat shim. Will call out pinned users in migration note.

marta (sdk-ts): TS will do 3.5.0 with same. Also suggest adding an opt-out env var `RW_ROUTE_LEGACY` for customers that cannot upgrade quickly.

leo (console): console will consume canonical_route when available and show a migration badge for routes using legacy headers. Also will add a UI filter to hide legacy rows.

owen (eng-platform): ops-bot, schedule canary rollout of strict parser to 10% of traffic after SDK releases. ops-bot: acknowledged, runbook rb-710 created.

ops-bot: scheduled canary rollout (10%) for 2024-09-10T08:00Z.

rachel (devex): I'll draft customer comms and a short FAQ explaining negotiation header and how to opt-out. Action items: SDK owners prepare releases; eng-platform to publish spec; console to add canonical_route support. We'll sync in next weekly SDK owners meeting. :thumbsup:
